title: WASTI NEXUS model and capability governance registry
policy: This is a capability and legal-governance catalogue, not a claim that every entry is downloadable, runnable or enabled. The existing twelve pinned GGUFs in nexus-model-catalog.json remain the only verified Drive archive-ready Android catalogue. Every additional entry remains disabled until exact checkpoint provenance, licence, checksum, runtime and hardware validation pass.
storage_policy: Google Drive through Android Storage Access Framework is the sole user-controlled archive for model weights, datasets, adapters, evaluation reports and exported GGUFs. Cloudflare R2/KV/D1/Workers AI are not model storage or inference dependencies.
inference_policy: Self-hosted open weights incur no vendor per-token charge when run on user-owned hardware, but are not unlimited: hardware capacity, heat, battery, bandwidth, power, software support and concurrency still impose limits. Hosted APIs are separate and may be paid or quota-limited.
cloudflare_policy: Cloudflare Workers AI inference is disabled. The optional Worker gateway may relay to a separately configured self-hosted HTTPS origin, but is not a GPU host and is never the primary or offline route.
